CalibLevel.Description: Root mean square value of the oscillating reference quantity.

CalibFrequency.Description: Frequency of the oscillating reference quantity.

CalibFactor.Description: Calibration factor calculated by dividing CalibLevel by the measured voltage values that represent the oscillating physical quantity.

CalibTime.Description: Calibration time required to determine CalibFactor.

StabilityTolerance.Description: Relative deviation of the standard deviation from the mean of the signal. Used to check the stability of the calibration.
